explained.tdh.versions.site.label: On {site}
explained.tdh.versions.site.title: {count} boost schedules since {year}
explained.tdh.versions.site.body: Each version changed the boost: what a full set pays, and how many seasons can pay. Before TDH v1.1 there were no seasons: 6529.io's code, from its first published commit, boosted a full set of every card. The specification restates only the current version, TDH v1.4, and the daily comparison checks only that one.
explained.tdh.versions.tableSource: The versions with seasons are as 6529.io's own Historic boosts page and current rules give them. The first row, before seasons, is from 6529.io's backend code, public on GitHub, at the commits How we know names. The daily comparison does not check these schedules.

explained.tdh.versions.chart.label: The full-set boost from seasons, version by version
explained.tdh.versions.chart.caption: Each step is one version: the full-set boost from seasons while it was in effect. Today's version is blue; the dashed line is its ceiling from seasons alone, reached once every season it names pays; extra sets and Gradients add to it.

explained.tdh.versions.spec.title: One set of rules, renamed once
explained.tdh.versions.spec.body: P26 names the rules by a rule version that every result carries, and a new TDH version on 6529.io is a new rule version (D137).
explained.tdh.versions.spec.list: The rule versions of the specification
explained.tdh.versions.v14.body: The specification's name, from {date} (D137), for the rules 6529.io runs as TDH v1.4, with four-wallet consolidation (D136). Registry {registry}, rule ID {ruleId}. Not frozen until launch: changes before it, such as D131's netting and D136's four wallets, stay TDH v1.4; from launch on, any change is a new rule version (P26 §10).
